title: decisions-lint rule file
description: A set of nuanced rules that decisions.yaml imports. Each rule names the declarations it judges, the question it asks the decision model, and which answers violate it.

version.description: The rule file format version; always 1.

rules.description: The rules of this file, keyed by rule id.

ruleId.description: a rule id made of lower-case letters, digits, dots and hyphens, such as cohesion.method-belongs-to-class

description.description: What the rule protects, shown by the rules command.

severity.description: How a violation is reported; error fails the check by default.

enabled.description: Whether the rule runs; set false in decisions.yaml to switch off an imported rule.

paths.description: File globs relative to decisions.yaml the rule applies to; omit to apply to every configured path.

exclude.description: File globs relative to decisions.yaml the rule skips.

context.description: How much source the model reads with the target: the declaration alone, its whole class, or its whole file.

violations.description: The answers that violate the rule, each with the message and the fix to report.

target.description: Which declarations of a matching file the rule judges.

kind.description: The kind of declaration to judge; file judges the whole file once.

visibility.description: Keep only methods or properties with one of these visibilities.

names.description: Keep only declarations whose short name matches one of these globs.

exclude_names.description: Drop declarations whose short name matches one of these globs, such as __*.

static.description: Keep only static (true) or only non-static (false) declarations.

decision.description: The question the model answers about each target.

type.description: predicate asks whether a statement holds, choice picks one option, score places the target on a scale.

instructions.description: The question, with {name}, {class}, {signature} and other placeholders filled from the target.

propertyNames.description: an option name made of letters, digits, underscores and hyphens

choices.description: For a choice: option name to description.

levels.description: For a score: the level descriptions from lowest (0) to highest.

threshold.description: The probability (predicate) or confidence (choice, score) a violation needs; 0.5 when omitted.

violation.description: One answer that violates the rule.

answer.description: The violating answer: true or false for a predicate, an option name for a choice.

min_score.description: For a score: the lowest violating score, inclusive.

max_score.description: For a score: the highest violating score, inclusive.

message.description: What is wrong, with placeholders such as {name} and {class}.

fix.description: What to change so the rule passes, with the same placeholders.
